title: Harden GeneratedCreatureData array immutability
description:
Prevent GeneratedCreatureData from exposing caller-owned mutable Color[] storage across the pure-generation to Unity-assembly boundary. Preserve the existing resolved/output architecture; this is a bounded contract-hardening task, not a new output model.

## Scope
- Defensively copy generated colors at construction.
- Expose colors read-only to consumers.
- Update the Unity assembly boundary to consume the read-only representation.
- Add focused regression coverage for aliasing and null input.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Mutating the constructor input array after construction cannot mutate GeneratedCreatureData.
- Consumers cannot cast the Colors property back to the original mutable array.
- Existing generation output remains equivalent.
- No second generated-output authority is introduced.

## Validation
- Runtime and runtime-test builds pass.
- Focused GeneratedCreatureData tests pass in Unity when available.
- git diff --check passes.

comments.body: Takeover audit 2026-09-07: confirmed GeneratedCreatureData exposed its constructor-owned Color[] directly, allowing downstream mutation of generated state. Reworked the boundary to defensively copy colors and expose IReadOnlyList<Color>; CreatureMeshGenerator now converts the read-only view only at the Unity Mesh.SetColors boundary. Added focused regression coverage for post-construction aliasing and null colors. Unity execution remains an external validation gate when an editor is available.
